programmes.name: Start-up Innovation Projects
programmes.funding_amount_text: Not stated as a sum; the page gives a share of costs only.
programmes.funding_rate_text: Up to 70 per cent of direct project costs; the start-up pays at least 30 per cent.
programmes.how_to_apply: Apply on the Innosuisse application platform once the stated requirements are met.
programmes.deadline_text: Projects can be submitted on an ongoing basis; the page asks for submission at least eight weeks before a meeting of the Innovation Council. Meeting dates are not in the text read.
programmes.eligibility_notes: Swiss-registered start-up about to enter the market for the first time, no more than five years old (ten in exceptional cases), fewer than 50 full-time equivalent staff. Only the start-up is funded, not research partners. The company needs the means to pay its own share.
programmes.notes: Page lists five thematic subgroups: ICT, energy and environment, engineering, life sciences, social sciences and business management.

criteria.text: Headquarters in Switzerland and entered in the Swiss commercial register.
Not more than five years old when you apply (up to ten in exceptional cases).
Fewer than 50 full-time equivalent staff.

programmes.name: GO-Bio next

programmes.name: Women TechEU
programmes.organisation: EU-funded project run by a consortium; granting authority EISMEA
programmes.funding_amount_text: EUR 75,000 per beneficiary, non-dilutive, as stated.
programmes.how_to_apply: Start with the phase 1 eligibility check, reached from the active calls page.

programmes.eligibility_notes: Early-stage deep tech start-up founded or co-founded by a woman in a top management role, women holding at least 25 per cent of shares, registered for between six months and five years, technology readiness level 4 to 6, less than EUR 1 million equity raised. Registered in an EU Member State or Horizon Europe associated country, as the programme's FAQ lists them.
